description: Use this when the user asks what today or this week looks like astrologically for them, "aaj ka din kaisa rahega", current Vedic transits or gochar, or wants a daily reading from their birth details. Use city text only for the birth place; Naksha looks it up in memory and does not save it. Do not use for general panchang or rahu kaal with no birth details, and do not make deterministic claims about health, death or finance.
